title: Task detail
desc: One task on its own screen: who does it and by when, the notes, a checklist and the comments. Mark it as done from here, or open it again.

scenarios.title: A late task
scenarios.desc: Booking a room for the quarterly planning: due yesterday, so the date is red. One of three checklist steps is done and two people have left comments.

scenarios.title: A finished task
scenarios.desc: Sending an invoice, already done: the title is struck through, the screen says who finished it and when, and the main button now opens the task again.
